name: RAINJOKE
source:
A Mortifying Love Story between a Knight and a Maid.

You are "Rainbow", you want to maintain your good standing. You are "Joke", you are going to mess it up for her. 

[From [url=https://slitherbop.itch.io/rainjoke]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個發生在騎士和女僕之間、讓人恨不得找條地縫鑽進去的愛情故事。

你是「彩虹」，想保住自己一貫的好名聲。你是「玩笑」，你要把她的好名聲攪個稀爛。

［摘自[url=https://slitherbop.itch.io/rainjoke]itch.io[/url]］
